From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement intake & vendor setup — Redwood Inference

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the call today — really enjoyed meeting the Acme Analytics team. As discussed, I wanted to follow up with the procurement readiness checklist and next steps so we can move you to a trial/PO quickly. Key items we covered: 

- Commercial path: you indicated preference for a PO (monthly invoicing) vs. corporate card. Confirmed that marketplace (AWS Marketplace) is optionally of interest.
- Procurement docs we usually provide: vendor packet (includes W-9/W-8, standard GPO), bank details for ACH, and our vendor portal for onboarding.
- Timeline: sample PO + vendor setup typically completes in ~1-2 weeks once we have the packet + vendor form filled.

Can you confirm the procurement contact (if different from this thread), and whether Acme requires any additional forms (vendor setup portal link, custom vendor questionnaire, or payment terms)? If you want us to send the vendor packet and W-9 now, I can attach them and loop in our billing contact.

Attached: vendor packet (stub), W-9.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm procurement contact and PO process (portal vs email).
2) I'll send the vendor packet + DocuSign for signature and provide bank/ACH details for supplier setup.
3) Rachel (cc'd) will handle invoicing and billing contact details.

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (application/pdf), W-9_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake & vendor setup — Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that matches my notes. Procurement here is Alex (cc'd) and procurement@acme-analytics.com for the vendor portal intake. A few quick items: 

- We will be processing via PO (standard) rather than card. Our legal review is typically light for SaaS but we do require a completed vendor packet + W-9 and banking details for ACH.
- We also use a vendor portal for onboarding; please provide the vendor packet as a single PDF and a contact we can reach for any missing info.
- Regarding marketplace: we are piloting through AWS Marketplace for some purchases — that might be preferable for procurement consistency, but we still need Redwood's vendor packet for internal records.

Could you attach the full vendor packet and W-9, and include bank/ACH routing or instructions? If possible, also include a statement of scope for the initial pilot (approx. seats/usage) so procurement can put together the PO.

Thanks,
Jill
Director, Finance Operations
Acme Analytics
jill.turner@acme-analytics.com
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Hi Jill / Alex —

Attached is the vendor packet bundle you requested (single PDF), plus our W-9. I've also attached a short payment details spreadsheet with our banking info for ACH and sample invoice fields. 

For the pilot scope, here's a one-line summary you can include on the PO: 
- Redwood Inference — Pilot subscription (3 months) — up to 1M tokens/month — monthly invoicing, net 30.

If you prefer AWS Marketplace, we can enable that path — Rachel can advise on timing and whether it affects invoicing cadence.

Rachel — can you confirm the invoice contact and whether Marketplace purchases should be routed differently?

Sean — cc'ing you in case procurement requests any SOC2 artifacts or an SSO contact for the vendor portal.

Best,
Marissa

Quick note from legal: our standard vendor agreement (linked by Marissa) is typically accepted as-is for pilots. If Acme intends to redline, please send the markups and we'll route through our legal review. Typical turnaround for limited redlines is 3-5 business days.

If procurement prefers marketplace terms (AWS Marketplace), we can also accommodate that — it mainly affects billing flow and invoicing. Happy to sync if you want to run through any specific clauses.
